rules.requirement: Each night, choose an alive player: a chosen Demon swaps characters & alignments with you & is then poisoned.

assertingTests.name: the Snake Charmer swaps characters and alignments with the chosen Demon (SNV-SNAKECHARMER-01)
a Snake Charmer who becomes the Demon on the first night does not wake as it until the second (SNV-SNAKECHARMER-01)
the Snake Charmer has a step on every night choosing one player, and the Pit-Hag from the second night with every character (SNV-SNAKECHARMER-01, SNV-PITHAG-01)
a Snake Charmer who chooses the Demon swaps characters and alignments with it and poisons it for good, and the new Demon wakes tonight (SNV-SNAKECHARMER-01)
a Snake Charmer who chooses a player who is not the Demon, or who is poisoned, changes nothing, and a dead player is refused (SNV-SNAKECHARMER-01)
a Philosopher with the Snake Charmer's ability who chooses the Demon becomes the Demon, and the Demon becomes a poisoned Philosopher (SNV-SNAKECHARMER-01, SNV-PHILOSOPHER-01)
a healthy Snake Charmer who chooses the Demon swaps characters and alignments with it and poisons it (SNV-SNAKECHARMER-01)
a Snake Charmer who chooses a player who is not the Demon, or who is drunk or poisoned, changes nothing (SNV-SNAKECHARMER-01)
